invariants.rationale: If isTouchUp is true, calculation short-circuits; otherwise, for the main branch to execute, the touch must not be in the deadzone.

invariants.expression: knobPosition.x >= knobBounds.x - knobBounds.radius && knobPosition.x <= knobBounds.x + knobBounds.radius
invariants.rationale: The knobPosition.x cannot fall outside the circular knobBounds defined by its center and radius.

invariants.expression: knobPosition.y >= knobBounds.y - knobBounds.radius && knobPosition.y <= knobBounds.y + knobBounds.radius
invariants.rationale: The knobPosition.y is also restricted by the bounds of the circle at (x,y) with given radius.
knobPercent is normalized if it would otherwise exceed length 1; thus, its length is always at most 1.
If not touch up and the point is inside knobBounds, knobPosition is set directly to (x, y).
